items: After the 2 included rounds of comments
Submission within 48 hours of complete documents
Mobile notary: weekend, holiday or urgent

included: Application prep: building permit application (BPA) and Notice of Commencement, including folio, legal description and owner-of-record lookups
Submission to the city or county
Email and phone communication with the permitting office on your behalf
Status tracking and follow-up until approval, with uploads to your project portal or shared folder

excluded: City, county and agency fees, including NOC recording (paid by the client at cost)
